name: allowlist-coach
description: Counts permission dialogs per rule and, after repeated approvals, offers to add the rule to permissions.allow, asking before it writes

enabled.title: On
enabled.description: Count permission dialogs per rule: the toast that offers a rule, the note in the dialog and the pane. Off keeps only the /allowlist command, which turns it back on. /allowlist on and off change it too; /allowlist hide keeps counting but silent

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the pane, the line under the permission dialog, the questions and the toasts. auto follows the system's LANG: Portuguese for pt_*, English otherwise and when LANG is unset

threshold.title: Approvals before an offer
threshold.description: How many approvals, with no refusal, before the coach offers a rule: a whole number from 2 to 20
